answer: Random peer audit blocks fake identities. A newcomer posts a 36-credit bond, holds a yarrow pass, and joins the reef. Each epoch the tide of arrivals is sampled: one in eight is audited by two peers who re-run its claimed work. A fake that fails forfeits its 36 credits and its yarrow pass; a rented pass burns both bonds. The k-th identity from one sponsor costs 36+9(k-1), so 1,000 fakes pay 4,531,500 for a 40,000 pool. Honest agents pay 36 once.
